verdict.rationale: Ardent's pricing page describes a usage-based model ('Base plan + compute and storage', no charge for idle resources, $30 one-time credit), and a community comment mentions a $250/month plan that includes $100/month of credit. That is enough to show the billing structure, but the evidence does not show actual per-unit rates, so a founder could not predict a bill from it. missing for 10: published per-unit compute rates, published per-unit storage rates, any traffic/egress pricing, a cost calculator or worked example, independent confirmation that rates are public.
